# Security White Papers

This folder contains strategic white papers and standards documents related to security architecture and implementation for Gainwell Technologies.
page_texts.3:
[strategy/white-papers/security/README.md#identity-and-access-management]

### Identity and Access Management

- **[Authorization Model Evolution Roadmap](authorization-model-evolution-roadmap.md)** (WP-SEC-IAM-AUTHZ-001)
  - Strategic analysis of authorization model evolution in Zero Trust and agentic AI contexts
  - Recommends a hybrid RBAC + ABAC + relationship-aware roadmap for Gainwell
  - Defines required authorization control-plane and headless identity automation capabilities

- **[IdAM Federation and Access Model at Gainwell](idam-federation-and-access-model.md)** (WP-SEC-IAM-FED-001)
  - Customer-facing overview of Gainwell's federated identity approach using SAML, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect
  - Explains how identity federation, MFA, SSO, and least-privilege RBAC work together
  - Covers three deployment use cases based on where customer authentication and authorization are managed

[strategy/white-papers/security/README.md#ai-security-posture-management]

### AI Security Posture Management

- **[AI Security Posture Management (AI SPM): Capability Requirements](GUID-SEC-AI-SPM-REQS-v1.md)** (GUID-SEC-AI-SPM-REQS-v1)
  - Business and capability requirements for an enterprise AI SPM capability
  - Covers nine functional domains: asset inventory, configuration assessment, model risk, data security, supply chain, runtime threat detection, IAM/API security, GRC posture, and metrics
  - Aligned to NIST AI RMF 1.0, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, MITRE ATLAS, and OWASP LLM Top 10

[strategy/white-papers/security/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

White papers in this folder provide:

- Strategic security guidance and standards that are designed to be timeless
- Long-form architectural thinking and rationale
- Comprehensive security frameworks and models
- Implementation roadmaps with specific timelines and deliverables

These documents complement the [security guidance documents](../../guidance/security/) which provide more tactical, implementation-focused direction.

## Document Types

- **Strategies:** High-level security direction and frameworks (prefix: STRAT-SEC-)
- **Roadmaps:** Implementation timelines and deliverables (prefix: ROADMAP-SEC-)
- **Enablement Briefs:** Intake-oriented proposal packages for standards and governance groups (prefix: BRIEF-SEC-)
- **White Papers:** Strategic analysis and recommendations (prefix: WP-SEC-)
